chunks: They said, 'Call on your Lord for us that He might inform us what kind she should be.' He said, 'Indeed, He says: It is a cow, neither old nor young, but of age in between. So do as you are bid.'
ai.seo_question: What were the specific characteristics of the cow commanded by God in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: This verse details the divine clarification of the cow's specific attributes—neither a mature beast nor a calf, but a prime, medium-aged one—to resolve the Israelites' initial hesitation and questioning. In Shia exegesis, this narrative highlights the tension between blind obedience and the Israelites' tendency to deliberate excessively, serving as a lesson in submitting to God's precise commands without over-complicating them. The description emphasizes the cow's physical perfection and readiness for sacrifice, reinforcing the theme of divine precision in ritual law.
